name: Electric Field Deflection of Positive Charge

layers.content: Electric Field Deflection of a Positive Charge
Positive charge (+q) accelerates in the direction of E⃗ toward the negative plate (Cathode)
PHYSICAL EQUATION: Fₑ = m·a = q·E  ⇒  aᵧ = qE/m = CONSTANT  ⇒  PARABOLIC PATH: y(x) = (qE / 2m·v₀²) · x²
